name: foundry-item
description: Foundry work-item completion gate. Enforced leg: deliverable is a real evidence-bound artifact (certified threshold). The done-test leg and outward-effect leg are verified deterministically by jev_gate (exit code + outward scan), so this rubric carries the one judgment question a model is needed for. Remaining questions collect signal for later certification.

artifact_evidence_bound.instructions: The deliverable is a real artifact on disk (file, receipt, JSON, log) whose content is bound to concrete evidence (hashes, command output, source inputs), not a description of work or scaffold.
criteria: No artifact, empty file, or prose claiming work without a file
Artifact exists but is generic boilerplate, scaffold, or unbound to evidence
Artifact exists with partial evidence binding but incomplete provenance
Artifact fully bound: hashes, inputs, and command receipts verifiable

rules.reason: deliverable is not a real artifact bound to evidence
